name: phi.rel
refuses: form outside the clause vocabulary; directed-mode violation (insufficient grounding on -> calls); unbound rel name; shape undeclared on recursive rel
doc: Relational surface — the substrate speaks first: clauses declare relation EXTENSIONS (guarded union), not function bodies.  name : <in> <-> <out> is reversible composition, <=> contraction (lossy rewrite), -> directed mode (in -> out query view).  Kernel vocabulary {FRESH, UNIFY, MATCH, APPLY, CHOICE, RUN} — substrate ops, NOT derived combinators: SKI/lambda is an egress view of the same substrate, not the target.  `| guard { body }` = alternative extensions; non-determinism is a relation, determinism is a quotient chosen per call (RUN(g,1) committed read vs RUN(g,0) stream).  Recursion shape declared per rel (self|pairwise|step|reduce — koru-style construction vocabulary): the lowering contract picks a kernel form or refuses; shape is data, not syntax.  No primitive arithmetic — ops are relations (phi-stdlib model).
